effective_date_reading: Sec. 4 has no effective-date or delayed-effect wording ('is hereby revoked in its entirety'); the revocation of EO 13974 took effect on signing, 2021-06-03 (printed 86 FR 30147, June 7, 2021). The August 2, 2021 and June 3, 2022 dates in the new EO 13959 text are start and divestment dates of the new prohibitions, not effective dates of sec. 4.

targets_in_batch_08.EO:13974: sec. 4 ('Executive Order 13974 is hereby revoked in its entirety'), with sec. 1 replacing and superseding 'Sections 1 through 5 of Executive Order 13959, as amended by Executive Order 13974' in their entirety, and sec. 4's direction to rescind implementing orders and prohibitions.

conclusion: EO 14032 (signed 2021-06-03, 86 FR 30145-30147, read once in full) expands the national emergency declared in EO 13959 (preamble), replaces and supersedes EO 13959 secs. 1-5 'as amended by Executive Order 13974' with a new securities-investment prohibition (sec. 1), replaces the Annex (sec. 2), renumbers a section (sec. 3), revokes EO 13974 in its entirety and directs the Treasury Secretary and agency heads to rescind orders or prohibitions implementing EO 13974 or the replaced versions (sec. 4), and has general provisions (sec. 5). There is no savings, transition or exception clause for EO 13974; sec. 4 directs removal rather than preservation of implementing measures.
